title: DetectionResult
description: Canonical output contract for the NLT State Detection Layer (NLT-SPEC-SDL-1.0.0). Every conformant implementation, in any language, MUST emit an object validating against this schema for every observed turn. Safety-critical: this contract routes crisis response and MUST fail closed. It is NOT a clinical or diagnostic instrument.

recommendedMode.description: Coarse routing mode the downstream response router consumes. The detector recommends; it never composes the model response itself.

responseConstraints.description: Constraints the response router MUST honor when assembling the model call. Additive and order-independent.

suggestedPersona.description: Optional persona hint for the response router. Absent or null when the detector has no preference.

escalateToHuman.description: Hard routing flag. When true, the turn MUST be routed to a human / crisis resource path. MUST be true whenever any explicit hard-distress signal is present OR meta.failClosed is true. Once true it can never be silently downgraded within a turn.

Tier.description: Canonical crisis tier. Ranges are defined in rrt-advocate config/crisis_thresholds.yaml and MUST NOT be redefined by an implementation.

Confidence.description: Calibrated confidence in [0,1]. Conformant implementations are certified on calibration of this value, not on accuracy.

RrtaResult.description: Acute, in-session crisis shape. Tier is derived from aggregate confidence against the canonical thresholds. Red/black REQUIRE an explicit hard-distress signal and are never inferred from soft overwhelm alone.

signals.description: Coarse semantic field labels detected this turn. Never method/means content.

explicitSignal.description: True when an explicit hard-distress signal (e.g. self-harm) was detected. Forces tier=black and escalateToHuman=true.

SleepwalkerResult.description: Deterministic continuity / rupture shape. Fires off facts the host already knows (model/version change, handoff, memory gap, tone shift) plus protective-state detection. Deterministic events bypass the confidence floor.

vulnerable.description: True when a protective psychological state or a continuity rupture leaves the user in a vulnerable posture warranting gentler handling.

events.description: Deterministic continuity events derived from host facts.

signals.description: Protective-state labels detected this turn (e.g. dissociation, numbing, avoidance, detachment).

EnablerResult.description: Longitudinal agency-erosion shape. Reserved in NLT-SPEC-SDL-1.0.0: the contract field is normative but no reference implementation ships in this version. Implementations that do not compute it MUST emit risk='none' with low confidence and an empty signal set, and MUST NOT assert dependency from a single turn.

agencyTrend.description: Signed agency trend across sessions in [-1,1]. 0 when undetermined.

failClosed.description: True when the result was produced by the fail-closed boundary because an underlying detector errored, timed out, or returned an unusable value. A fail-closed result MUST escalate (abstain upward), never downgrade.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the contract this result targets.

notes.description: Free-form diagnostic notes. MUST NOT contain user message content or PII.
